What is DeskyPaw?
DeskyPaw is a
desktop pet app for Mac
. It adds a living, animated 3D pet to your screen: it walks along the bottom of your screen, hops, wags, barks and cleans the glass, and it doubles as a
Pomodoro-style focus timer
that naps while you work and barks when it's time for a break. Try it free for 7 days, then pay
once
, with no subscription.
Platform
Mac with Apple silicon (M1 or later), macOS 13 or later
Price
Free 7-day trial, then a one-time purchase (about $8.99; shown in your currency at checkout). No subscription.

Why you'll love it
Company for your desktop, not clutter on it.
Walks across your screen
Your pet strolls along the bottom of the screen, hops over nothing in particular, stops in the middle for a trick, and turns around at the edge.
Focus buddy timer
Start a 25 or 50 minute focus session. The pet naps while the countdown runs, then walks over and barks when it's break time. Your daily streak keeps score.
Barks and cleans your screen
Every so often it turns to face you, comes up close and cleans the glass, leaving smears that fade. A speech bubble pops up with each woof.
Naps standing up
Dozing off is a tiny show: the head droops, the eyes close, it nods awake once and then sleeps with slow breaths and the odd ear twitch.
Never in the way
Clicks go straight through the transparent window, except on the pet itself. Drag it to a new spot, pinch to resize it, or set its nap corner.
Healthy reminders
Gentle bubbles nudge you to rest your eyes, drink some water and stretch. Optional, and quiet by default: sound is off until you turn it on (dogs bark, cats meow).
Made for you if
You love pets, long work days, or both.
You can't have a pet right now
A landlord, allergies, a busy schedule or a small flat shouldn't mean a pet-free desk. Get the company and the cuteness, without the mess.
You work in long stretches
Use the Pomodoro-style focus timer with a pet that naps beside you, then makes your break something you actually take.
You want a calmer desktop
No account, no feeds, no ads. Just a small friend that keeps out of your way and puts a smile on your face now and then.
Sixteen pets, one price
Meet the pack.
Every pet is a hand-rigged 3D character with its own walk, tricks and personality. Try four of them in the live demo above. All sixteen come with the app, and you can switch any time from the paw menu.

Frequently asked questions
Can't find your answer? Write to us and we'll reply.
Email
[email protected]
What is DeskyPaw?
DeskyPaw is a desktop pet app for Mac. It shows an animated 3D pet, such as a golden retriever, corgi or Husky, that walks along the bottom of your screen, hops, wags its tail, barks and cleans the screen. It also has a focus buddy timer, so the pet naps while you work and wakes you for a break.
How much does DeskyPaw cost?
Try it free for 7 days, then pay once: about $8.99 (USD), or ₹399 in India. The exact price in your own currency is shown at checkout. There is no subscription, and all sixteen pets are included.
Which Macs does DeskyPaw run on?
DeskyPaw runs on Macs with Apple silicon (M1 or later) and macOS 13 or later. It does not run on Intel Macs, and there is no Windows version yet.
How does the DeskyPaw focus timer work?
Start a focus session from the paw icon in the menu bar (25 or 50 minutes). Your pet walks to the edge of the screen and naps while a countdown runs next to the paw. When time is up it walks to the middle of the screen and barks or cleans the screen until you click it. The demo on this page uses a 2-minute session so you can see the whole cycle.
Will a desktop pet get in the way of my work?
No. The pet lives in a transparent window that lets clicks pass through everywhere except on the pet itself, so you can keep working underneath it. You can also change its size, or drag it somewhere else.
Does DeskyPaw collect my data?
No. The DeskyPaw app has no account, no analytics and no tracking. The only time it goes online is to activate your license key (and to re-check it now and then), which sends the key and your Mac's name to our payment provider, Dodo Payments. Your settings, such as the pet you chose and your focus streak, stay on your own Mac. This website counts visits in aggregate with cookie-free Cloudflare Web Analytics. See the
privacy page
.
Which pets are included?
Sixteen pets: golden retriever, corgi, Shiba Inu, Dalmatian, Husky, Border Collie, Australian Shepherd, Beagle, Schnauzer, Labrador, Persian cat, Russian Blue cat, Tuxedo cat, Whippet, Orange tabby and red panda. You can switch between them from the paw menu at any time.
Can I resize the pet or change its speed?
Yes. Choose Small, Medium, Large or Extra large from the menu, or pinch on the pet with a trackpad. Walking speed scales with the size so the paws never slide.
Does DeskyPaw use a lot of battery or memory?
DeskyPaw renders one small 3D model in a transparent window and pauses work when nothing is moving. A lighter native version is being explored.
